payload.markdown: > Branch feat/dst-simulation-TASK-014 (uncommitted). VAN→CREATIVE→PLAN→TECH_SPEC→IMPLEMENT→QA→CODE_REVIEW all DA-cleared PROCEED. 806/806 tests, npm run check exit 0, sim:coverage 32/39 exit 0, core engine byte-frozen.

Delivered a VOPR-style Deterministic Simulation Testing environment for @vedmalex/statemachine, additive behind a separate `@unstable ./sim` entry: seed-driven generator, all 7 fault kinds genuinely applied during real runs, Safety (I-1..I-12) + Liveness oracles, ddmin shrinker + runnable repro, perf-regression plane, and a mandatory programmatic capability-coverage CI gate. Core public API and bundle bytes unchanged.

- **UR-001 — FULLY.** Real engine driven deterministically through the TASK-013 clock/scheduler seam; bit-exact replay.
- **UR-002 — FULLY (after a corrected gap).** All 7 FaultKinds applied during real runs; 8-seed multi-kind bit-identical replay; fault-originated end-to-end repro through public ./sim. HONESTY NOTE: the fault-originated e2e violation is surfaced via a consumer reachability Invariant through the sanctioned public SimOptions.invariants slot (genuinely engine-driven on the real generator topology); the FROZEN INVARIANTS registry are clean-path checkers, and the emitted repro's literal FROZEN-INVARIANTS-wired path is the codegen-shape contract (the e2e re-executes the repro's replay through public runSimulation — fidelity option c).
- **UR-003 — FULLY.** Perf/load plane + public debug surface (wire/runSimulation/Simulator.step) + reproducible MinimalRepro.
- **UR-004 — COVERED, REGISTRY-SCOPED (honest, NOT literally exhaustive).** The mandatory gate enforces 32/39 capabilities; 7 are DOCUMENTED STRUCTURAL gaps with rationale + deep-equal pin + non-vacuous negative proof: event.onError (un-awaited, ErrorHandler returns void), event.onSuccess (never dispatched at runtime), queue.internal-before-external (engine drains internal-first so internal===0 at every observable boundary), string-method-resolved guard/action throws (unwrappable by config mutation), dormant queue.depth-bound.max-transition. invoke.cond is SYNCHRONOUS (types.ts:256) — not an error-fault path. "Cover ALL functionality" is honestly scoped to the registry, not a literal 100%.
- **UR-005 — FULLY.** Separate @unstable ./sim entry, core byte-frozen (zero ABI/dist leak), perf regression bands, full v1 fault set. ISS-043 RESOLVED as BRANCH B (documented shared-tsconfig coupling): a src/sim/** type error CAN block the core check/build — a MATERIAL UR-005 'core unaffected' posture acceptance, SIGNED OFF here (the byte-frozen-core island's own 800+-test suite gates every sim change; isolation deferred).

The IMPLEMENT phase produced DECOMPOSED-GREEN steps (each step's unit tests passed, the IMPLEMENT-exit Plan-Fidelity DA gate PROCEEDed) yet the CENTRAL capability — fault injection — was never wired into the driver: the harness fault functions existed + were unit-tested, but SimDriver.step used raw fireEvent and ignored FaultPlan (ISS-064). Per-module green + signature-fidelity review BOTH missed the missing integration seam; only the QA Coverage end-to-end probe (find→shrink→emit→re-execute through public ./sim) surfaced it. LESSON (→ CODING_RULES): a cross-module capability is NOT 'implemented' when its primitives merely exist + unit-test green — it requires an INTEGRATION / end-to-end test that drives the capability through the public surface. Per-step DoD must include an integration assertion for any capability that spans modules, and Plan-Fidelity review must check call-paths (is it CALLED?), not just presence of the function.

Dropped the node-18/20 build matrix; CI runs a single latest-LTS Node 24 leg (tier-a-node + tier-b + sim-nightly all Node 24); package.json engines >=24. This also resolved ISS-048 (dist-bytes + sim-perf baselines measured on node v24.9.0 = the CI node).

- ISS-055 (MED): add a falsifiable QUIET_FLUSH=16 margin/boundary test for the settle primitive (a scenario measuring actual max quiet-window depth + asserting headroom); observable predicate preserved exactly + AC-1/coverage backstops mean it is not blocking.
- ISS-068 (LOW): key the throw-fault single-shot latch by a structural site key (callbackKind+invokeIndex+opId) instead of FaultSite object identity (latent replay fragility only).
- ISS-067 (LOW): keep the documented note that reorder is observable only on a >=2-op fireMany window (single-op step() is a recorded no-op).
- ISS-047 (LOW): fix 3 cosmetic tech-spec line-citation off-by-ones AND the dist_byte_guard.test.ts:14 comment that still says node-20 (baseline JSON is correctly byte-compared; comment drift only after the Node-24 CI switch).
- Future (v1.1): drive a FROZEN-invariant fault-violation through the LITERAL emitted repro file end-to-end (subprocess), and let the generator optionally emit non-empty FaultPlans.

ISS-029..033 (CREATIVE), ISS-039..043 (PLAN), ISS-047 (partial), ISS-048 (CI Node 24), ISS-053/054 (IMPLEMENT HIGH: coverage-gate widening + dead public Safety path), ISS-061/062/063 (QA: e2e repro + AC-4 wording + qa.md materialization), ISS-064 (fault layer wired). All DA gates (CREATIVE/PLAN/TECH_SPEC/IMPLEMENT/QA/CODE_REVIEW) PROCEED.
